title: Outbound contact server runtime composition boundary
purpose: Resolve server-owned outbound contact runtime configuration and compose the canonical provider-neutral private contact provider composition without mutating the private route or executing contact.
requirements: Return undefined when outbound contact is disabled, missing, partial, malformed, or unsupported.
When validated configuration exists, reuse createInsuranceOutboundContactProviderComposition from INS-007V.
Accept transport as an injected dependency; do not obtain global fetch internally.
Do not import cloudflare:workers in the resolver module.
Do not read process.env or import.meta.env.
Do not duplicate provider construction, CRM persistence, or orchestration logic.
tests: Disabled or incomplete runtime environment resolves to undefined without constructing usable composition.
Complete enabled Telnyx runtime environment resolves to provider-neutral composition with providerName telnyx.
Composition uses the injected fake transport if its provider is explicitly exercised in a focused test.
Resolver source contains no cloudflare runtime import, global fetch acquisition, route coupling, or requestContact execution.
boundaries: No Cloudflare binding or wrangler mutation.
No live call, SMS, or email.
No provider account activation or configuration.
No routing, scoring, automatic producer assignment, second CRM, or Sesh changes.
nextBoundary: A later explicitly authorized slice may pass the private route's existing server runtime environment and a server transport into this resolver; actual requestContact execution remains a separate boundary.
